summary: Dependency pinned to off-registry third-party tarball with install script executed on npm install
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json pin the sole dependency `packet-table-thread-stream` to an HTTPS tarball at `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/packet-table-thread-stream` — not the npm registry and not a documented publisher domain. The shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so on `npm install` npm fetches this off-registry artifact and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. The package metadata is placeholder ("Generated package", example.com repository), and the tarball URL is unversioned and mutable, meaning the bytes executed at install time can change at any point without a package update. The effect is that installing this package resolves and runs arbitrary code hosted on a third-party artifact host outside the npm registry trust boundary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
